    Ported from TauCeti (TauCeti.RingTheory.LocalRing.Basic, commit 580b6f9d5, Apache 2.0).

    Basic facts about local rings #

    This file records basic facts about possibly noncommutative local rings. Their only idempotents are 0 and 1; this fact applies to endomorphism rings in the Krull-Schmidt theorem. In characteristic two the idempotent criterion identifies the zeros of the Artin–Schreier map t ↦ t² + t, without a finiteness assumption.

    Main results #

    • IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isLocalRing: an idempotent of a local ring is 0 or 1.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsLocalRing.isDedekindFiniteMonoid: a local ring is Dedekind-finite.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.isUnit_add_of_isUnit_of_not_isUnit: adding a nonunit to a unit in a local ring yields a unit.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.isUnit_sub_of_not_isUnit_of_isUnit: subtracting a unit from a nonunit in a local ring yields a unit.
    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsLocalRing.sq_add_self_eq_zero_iff: in characteristic two, t² + t = 0 exactly when t = 0 or t = 1.
    • Nat.Coprime.isUnit_natCast: if a natural number is not a unit, every coprime natural number is a unit.
    • IsCoprime.isUnit_or_isUnit: of two coprime elements of a commutative local semiring, one is a unit.
    • IsLocalRing.sub_one_mem_maximalIdeal_of_card_residueField_eq_two: when the residue field has two elements, every unit is congruent to 1 modulo the maximal ideal, and IsLocalRing.two_mem_maximalIdeal_of_card_residueField_eq_two: 2 lies in the maximal ideal.

    theorem IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_or_eq_one_of_isLocalRing {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] {a : R} (ha : IsIdempotentElem a) :
    a = 0 ∨ a = 1

    An idempotent of a possibly noncommutative local ring is 0 or 1.

    source
    instance LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsLocalRing.isDedekindFiniteMonoid {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] :
    IsDedekindFiniteMonoid R

    A local ring is Dedekind-finite: a left inverse is also a right inverse.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.isUnit_add_of_isUnit_of_not_isUnit {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] {a b : R} (ha : IsUnit a) (hb : ¬IsUnit b) :
    IsUnit (a + b)

    In a local ring, adding a nonunit to a unit yields a unit.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.isUnit_sub_of_not_isUnit_of_isUnit {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] {a b : R} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) (hb : IsUnit b) :
    IsUnit (a - b)

    In a local ring, subtracting a unit from a nonunit yields a unit.

    source
    @[simp]
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsLocalRing.sq_add_self_eq_zero_iff {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] [CharP R 2] (t : R) :
    t ^ 2 + t = 0 ↔ t = 0 ∨ t = 1

    Over a local ring of characteristic two, the zeros of t ↦ t² + t are 0 and 1.

    source
    theorem IsCoprime.isUnit_or_isUnit {R : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [IsLocalRing R] {a b : R} (h : IsCoprime a b) :
    IsUnit a ∨ IsUnit b

    Of two coprime elements of a commutative local semiring, one is a unit: a relation u * a + v * b = 1 makes one of the two summands a unit.

    source
    theorem Nat.Coprime.isUnit_natCast {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [IsLocalRing R] {m n : ℕ} (h : m.Coprime n) (hn : ¬IsUnit ↑n) :
    IsUnit ↑m

    In a possibly noncommutative local ring, a natural number coprime to a nonunit natural number is a unit.

    source
    theorem IsLocalRing.sub_one_mem_maximalIdeal_of_card_residueField_eq_two {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (hR : Nat.card (ResidueField R) = 2) {u : R} (hu : IsUnit u) :
    u - 1 ∈ maximalIdeal R

    When the residue field of a commutative local ring has two elements, every unit is congruent to 1 modulo the maximal ideal: its residue is a nonzero element of 𝔽₂.

    source
    theorem IsLocalRing.two_mem_maximalIdeal_of_card_residueField_eq_two {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (hR : Nat.card (ResidueField R) = 2) :
    2 ∈ maximalIdeal R

    When the residue field of a commutative local ring has two elements, 2 lies in the maximal ideal: the residue field has characteristic two.
